title: Higgsfield + Claude Opus 5 builds animated low-poly Blender world in-prompt
summary: Demo thread: Higgsfield plugin with Claude Opus 5 builds a full low-poly forest scene inside Blender from prompts—terrain, lake, lighting, camera—then Meshy 6 drops a rigged character and animates a walk without leaving Blender.
question_it_answers: Can an agent plugin inside Blender go from empty cube to animated low-poly world via prompts alone?

claims.text: Claude Opus 5 through the Higgsfield plugin generates terrain, lake, mountains, trees, paths, lighting, and camera into a real .blend file from one prompt.
claims.evidence: Full forest appears in the real .blend file
claims.subject: blockout-to-video-flythrough

claims.text: A follow-on prompt uses Meshy 6 to generate a rigged low-poly adventurer and animate walking in the same Blender scene.
claims.evidence: Meshy 6 generates a low-poly adventurer — rigged and ready. Drops him straight into the scene.
claims.subject: blockout-to-video-flythrough

judge_hints.why_must_read: In-Blender agent world-build demo distinct from export-to-video-model pipeline.
